summary: Walks the OrderLines DAO recordset for a given order, sums line totals, and writes the running total back to the parent Orders row. Heavy use of default-property access (bang notation) and late-bound recordset navigation typical of mid-1990s VB6 DAO code.

inputs.name: orderId
inputs.semantic: Primary key of the Orders row to update.

invariants.claim: The Orders.Total field is updated to the exact sum of OrderLines.Total for rows where OrderLines.OrderId = orderId.
Currency precision is preserved end-to-end; no Double conversion happens at any point.

default_property_usages.expansion: Bang notation on a DAO Recordset retrieves the .Value of the named Field. In the EF Core port this becomes typed property access on a strongly-typed OrderLine entity.
default_property_usages.translation_hint: EF Core 10: `var total = line.Total;` after `var lines = await ctx.OrderLines.Where(l => l.OrderId == orderId).ToListAsync();`

default_property_usages.expansion: Parenthesised access is also a default-property reach. Same semantics as bang-notation but slightly different syntax — the LLM extraction must surface both forms.

late_binding_calls.subject: rsLines
late_binding_calls.contract: Advances the DAO Recordset cursor by one row. Combined with EOF check, drives the summation loop. The SME confirmed rsLines is a typed DAO.Recordset, not a Variant — but the compiler doesn't see that statically because DAO is late-bound by convention in this codebase.

com_interop_contracts.contract: Standard DAO 3.x recordset surface. The customer's installation has DAO 3.6 registered via Tools → References at the project level, but the code reads as if it were late-bound — `Dim rsLines As Recordset` (untyped to the compiler because the type alias isn't qualified).
com_interop_contracts.replacement_hint: EF Core 10 with `DbContext` + `DbSet<OrderLine>`. Direct DAO retained only if the customer still has .mdb files in production with no migration path.

side_effects.description: Writes to the Orders.Total field (rsOrder.Edit / rsOrder.Update sequence).

edge_cases.description: Order has no lines (rsLines.EOF on first read). The routine writes 0 to Orders.Total without iterating.
